name: Chickweed

facts.what: Tender tops, leaves, and starry flowers
facts.how: Raw, by the bowl, or pesto
facts.where: Shaded beds, damp lawns, winter gardens

caution: Confirm the single line of hairs running up one side of the stem and the absence of milky sap; scarlet pimpernel, the look-alike, has square-ish stems, orange flowers, and no hair line.

sections.title: Identification
sections.body: A sprawling mat of small oval leaves with white flowers so deeply split their five petals look like ten. Stretch a stem gently: the skin breaks but an elastic inner core holds.

sections.title: In the kitchen
sections.body: Chickweed eats like sprouts, mild and juicy. Scissor-harvest the top few inches and it regrows for weeks.
